editorial_thesis: Agent leverage is becoming an operational discipline: keep private context local, make delivery reviewable, evaluate computer use with evidence, and preflight the transport layer.

topic_groups.title: On-device Multimodal Retrieval
topic_groups.selection_rationale: A fresh open model release makes private, cross-modal search practical on ordinary devices; this fills a coverage gap after several days focused on hosted agent control planes.

sources.title: EmbeddingGemma 2
sources.why_selected: Google introduced a 740M Apache 2.0 model that maps text, code, images, audio, and video into one embedding space.
sources.usefulness: Prototype local search over client artifacts without sending raw media to a hosted index.

sources.title: Gemma documentation
sources.why_selected: The implementation contract matters more than the launch claim: model formats, runtimes, and supported embedding workflows determine portability.
sources.usefulness: Use the docs to pick a local runtime and define an embedding refresh job.

sources.title: Hugging Face model card
sources.why_selected: The model card is the inspectable weight and configuration surface for local evaluation.
sources.usefulness: Benchmark retrieval quality against Buildn’s own mixed text, screenshot, and recording corpus.

sources.title: Google AI Edge
sources.why_selected: Google’s edge runtime surface provides the deployment context for on-device inference.
sources.usefulness: Test memory, battery, and cold-start constraints before promising offline retrieval to a client.

topic_groups.title: Agentic Delivery Controls
topic_groups.selection_rationale: GitHub shipped several concrete control and collaboration changes on October 6: agent-activity telemetry repair, AI-scan visibility, and stacked pull requests. These are operational seams rather than another model headline.

sources.title: Restore Copilot agent activity metrics
sources.why_selected: GitHub says an IDE update is required to restore agent activity in Copilot usage metrics.
sources.usefulness: Treat telemetry as versioned infrastructure; verify that adoption dashboards still mean what operators think they mean.

sources.title: AI Scan enablement status
sources.why_selected: Security overview now surfaces whether AI Scan is enabled, making a control state visible at portfolio level.
sources.usefulness: Add “enabled, configured, observed” to client security scorecards.

sources.title: Stacked pull requests GA
sources.why_selected: Stacked pull requests are generally available, supporting smaller dependent review units and stack navigation.
sources.usefulness: Pair agent-generated changes with smaller reviewable slices instead of one opaque branch.

sources.title: Copilot code review API
sources.why_selected: The code review API adds a programmatic entry point and a new default effort level.
sources.usefulness: Use API review as a repeatable gate, not as a replacement for ownership or merge policy.

topic_groups.title: Professional Computer Use Needs Evidence
topic_groups.selection_rationale: OpenAI’s October 6 Ironclad collaboration is a useful signal beyond generic computer-use demos: complex professional workflows require simulated tasks, reusable terms, approvals, and reliability measurement.

sources.title: Advancing computer use with Ironclad
sources.why_selected: OpenAI described simulated contract tasks involving agreements, approvals, and reusable legal terms, and invited software companies to collaborate on difficult professional work.
sources.usefulness: Use the task framing as a template for evaluating domain-specific agents without exposing live client data.

sources.title: Agents API computer use
sources.why_selected: The computer-use API surface defines the tool boundary for agents that operate software rather than only return text.
sources.usefulness: Separate observation, action, approval, and post-action evidence in an integration contract.

sources.title: OpenAI Agents API
sources.why_selected: The hosted agent harness packages tool calling, context compaction, and sandboxed execution for longer workflows.
sources.usefulness: Compare hosted execution with local or client-controlled environments on data and audit requirements.

sources.title: OpenAI evaluations
sources.why_selected: Evaluation tooling provides the repeatable dataset and grader layer needed for task reliability.
sources.usefulness: Represent each professional workflow as a task set with explicit pass/fail evidence.

topic_groups.title: Secure Agent Transport at the Edge
topic_groups.selection_rationale: A concrete GitHub Enterprise TLS cutoff lands today and creates an immediate infrastructure check. It is a neglected but practical lane: agent systems fail at the transport and dependency boundary before model quality matters.

sources.title: X25519-only TLS ends for GHE.com
sources.why_selected: GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency stops accepting clients that offer only X25519; P-256 and P-384 remain supported.
sources.usefulness: Check proxies, runtimes, GitHub CLI versions, and security appliances used by build and agent workers.

sources.title: GitHub Enterprise Cloud docs
sources.why_selected: The residency documentation identifies the deployment context where this transport change applies.
sources.usefulness: Keep residency-specific endpoints in infrastructure inventories rather than assuming github.com parity.

sources.title: OpenSSL supported groups
sources.why_selected: OpenSSL’s supported-group configuration is the low-level control that can accidentally create an X25519-only client.
sources.usefulness: Inspect explicit group lists in agent runners and outbound proxies.

sources.title: GitHub CLI releases
sources.why_selected: CLI releases are a practical upgrade surface for developer and automation workers.
sources.usefulness: Test the exact CLI/runtime image used in CI before the next scheduled run.
